full_judgment:
(2) 	Is the suit bad for misjoinder and non-joinder of parties? 

 15. on the other. hand, Mr SK Siddique, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the defendant, categorically admits that the bunkers in question were received in the ship both at Port Said and at Hong Kong while the ship was under a time charter which specifically provides that the charterer would pay for the bunker, as such, the action in rem against the ship and its owner is not maintainable and is liable to be dismissed. In support of his submissions, he refers to the case of David Morgan vs Steamship "Castlegate" (1893) A C 38, Owner Of "Arild" vs Societe Anonyme De Navigation Hovrani 1923 Lloyd's List Law Rep KB 50 and The 'Yuta Bondarovskaya (1998) 2 Lloyd's Law Rep 357.
